读法说明. 带边框的卡片是英语原文, 左上角标出讲义页码 (Page N) 或幻灯片页码 (Slide N). 淡色底的框是中文讲解, 虚线框是补充, 红框标出原文错误. 课前讲义是主线, 幻灯片补模拟结果和课堂题. 可疑数值与课堂题答案已用 Python 核对; 本机没有 Rscript, 未直接运行 R.

学习目标与检验流程
Learning Goals and the NHST Workflow

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Given hypotheses and data, be able to identify an appropriate significance test from a list of common ones.
  2. Given hypotheses, data, and a suggested significance test, know how to look up details and apply the significance test.

本讲目标不是背检验公式, 而是先辨认数据结构和假设, 再查出相应统计量、零分布与 **p-value p 值**的算法.

知道如何查证也很重要: 分清概率分布、统计量、自由度和尾侧, 才能正确读懂软件输出, 并发现公式或表格中的排版错误.

这也是本讲保留红框的原因: 计算结果要与公式、数据和结论方向一起核对.

选择检验时先看: 比较一个均值还是多个均值, 方差是否已知, 两组是否独立或配对, 类别数据怎样构成. 知道检验名称后细节可以查, 适用条件不能省略.

每道例题都可以按同一顺序复述: 数据结构和假设是什么, 统计量怎样计算, 零分布及自由度是什么, 哪一侧算极端, 最后结论能说到哪一步. 这样比背整页公式更可靠.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1

In these notes we will collect together some of the most common significance tests, though by necessity we will leave out many other useful ones. Still, all significance tests follow the same basic pattern in their design and implementation, so by learning the ones we include you should be able to apply other ones as needed.

Designing a null hypothesis significance test (NHST):

  • Specify null and alternative hypotheses.
  • Choose a test statistic whose null distribution and alternative distribution(s) are known.
  • Specify a rejection region. Very often this is done implicitly by specifying a significance level α and a method for computing p-values based on the tails of the null distribution.
  • Compute power using the alternative distribution(s).

设计阶段先明确 H0​,HA​, 再选择零分布和备择分布都已知的统计量. 拒绝域常通过显著性水平 α 和尾概率规则间接给出, 功效则用具体备择分布计算.

这些步骤都发生在看数据之前. 若零分布未知, 就无法定义 p 值; 若备择分布未知, 就无法给出唯一功效.

把设计与运行分开, 还能让分析可复核: 别人可以先检查你的假设和拒绝规则是否合理, 再看同一规则在数据上给出什么结果, 而不是只接受最后一句「显著」.

Pages 1–2

Running a NHST:

  • Collect data and compute the test statistic.
  • Check if the test statistic is in the rejection region. Most often this is done implicitly by checking if p<α. If so, we ‘reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis’. Otherwise we conclude ‘the data does not support rejecting the null hypothesis’.

Note the careful phrasing: when we fail to reject H0​, we do not conclude that H0​ is true. The failure to reject may have other causes. For example, we might not have enough data to clearly distinguish H0​ and HA​, whereas more data might indicate that we should reject H0​.

运行阶段只按事先定好的规则收集数据、计算统计量并判断. p<α 就拒绝, 否则只能说数据不支持拒绝.

不拒绝不等于证明 H0​ 为真. 样本太少或功效太低时, 即使 HA​ 为真, 也可能得到不显著结果.

因此结论要与功效一起读: 高功效下的不拒绝较有信息量, 低功效下的不拒绝可能只是检验没有能力区分两种假设. 无论哪种情况, 都不把它写成「接受并证明原假设」.

Slide 6

You want to decide whether to reject H0​ in favor of HA​.

Design:

  • Design experiment to collect data relevant to hypotheses.
  • Choose text statistic x with known null distribution ϕ(x∣H0​).
  • Choose the significance level α and find the rejection region.
  • For a simple alternative HA​, use ϕ(x∣HA​) to compute the power.
  • Alternatively, you can choose both the significance level and the power, and then compute the necessary sample size.

Implementation:

  • Run the experiment to collect data.
  • Compute the statistic x and the corresponding p-value.
  • If p<α, reject H0​.

幻灯片补上一种设计方式: 同时指定显著性水平和目标功效, 再反推样本量. 这样能在实验前考虑「不显著是效应太小, 还是数据不足」.

实施时不再重新选择检验或门槛, 只计算统计量与 p 值, 按预设规则作决定.

原文笔误:Slide 6 写的是 Choose text statistic, 应为 Choose test statistic, 即选择检验统计量.

模拟与假设的概率
Simulation and Probabilities of Hypotheses

Studio 7 与模拟
Discussion of Studio 7 and simulation

Slide 3

What is a simulation?

  • Run an experiment with pseudo-random data instead of real-world real random data.
  • By doing this many times we can estimate the statistics for the experiment.

Why do a simulation?

  • In the real world we are not omniscient.
  • In the real world we don’t have infinite resources.

What was the point of Studio 7?

  • To simulate some simple significance tests and compare various frequencies.
  • Simulated P(reject∣H0​)≈ significance α
  • Simulated P(reject∣HA​)≈ power
  • P(H0​∣reject) can be anything; depends on the distribution of hypotheses, which we almost never know.

**simulation 模拟**用伪随机数据重复实验, 以频率估计概率. 在 H0​ 为真的重复实验中, 拒绝频率估计 α; 在 HA​ 为真的重复实验中, 拒绝频率估计功效.

这两个条件概率都以假设为条件, 并没有给出假设本身的概率. 要从 P(reject∣H0​) 得到 P(H0​∣reject), 还需要假设分布, 也就是先验.

模拟时必须先固定当前实验的假设, 再生成数据, 不能在同一条模拟序列里随意改变假设. 每种假设下的拒绝频率只估计该假设对应的拒绝率.

若把多种假设混合, 拒绝后各类假设所占比例还会受混合比例影响. 这正是后面 Problem 4 与单纯显著性、功效不同的地方.

Problem 2 中所有假设都是 H0​, 所以拒绝后 H0​ 为真的概率是 1; Problem 3 中所有假设都是 HA​, 对应概率是 0.

Problem 4 混合两类假设. 由计数, P(reject∣H0​)=344/6948≈0.04951, P(reject∣HA​)=628/3052≈0.20577, 分别估计显著性和功效.

拒绝后假设的分布则要用拒绝计数在两类之间的比例计算, 不能只读单类拒绝率.

具体计算分三步: 先从 H0​ 列取拒绝数 344, 再从 HA​ 列取拒绝数 628; 两类合计拒绝 972 次; 最后在拒绝集合内部比较 344 与 628.

因此 P(H0​∣reject)=344/972, 而 P(HA​∣reject)=628/972. 这里分母已经从各类原人数换成共同的拒绝总数, 与 P(reject∣H0​) 和 P(reject∣HA​) 的条件方向正好相反.

幻灯片错误:Problem 4 的 P(H0​∣reject) 写成了约 0.32. 按同一张表的计数应为 344/(344+628)=0.35391, 约 0.35; P(HA​∣reject)=628/972≈0.65 与此一致.

Slide 5

We run a two-sample t-test for equal means, with α=0.05, and obtain a p-value of 0.04. What are the odds that the two samples are drawn from distributions with the same mean?

(a) 19/1   (b) 1/19   (c) 1/20   (d) 1/24   (e) unknown

答案是 (e) unknown. p=0.04=P(当前或更极端的数据∣H0​), 不是 P(H0​∣data).

没有先验和备择假设下的数据分布, 无法算「均值相同」的赔率. 1/19 只是把 p/(1−p) 错当成假设赔率.

赔率 P(H0​∣D)/P(HA​∣D) 需要先验赔率与两假设下的似然比. p 值只给零假设下的尾概率, 既没有先验赔率, 也没有备择分布的完整信息.

总体参数与样本统计量
Population Parameters and Sample Statistics

3 总体参数与样本统计量
3 Population parameters and sample statistics

Page 2

Example 1. If we randomly select 10 men from a population and measure their heights we say that we have sampled the heights from the population. In this case the sample mean, say xˉ, is the mean of the sampled heights. It is a statistic and we know its value explicitly. On the other hand, the true average height of the population, say μ, is unknown and we can only estimate its value. We call μ a population parameter.

The main purpose of significance testing is to use sample statistics to draw conlusions about population parameters. For example, we might test if the average height of men in a given population is greater than 70 inches.

**sample statistic 样本统计量**由已收集的数据算出, 例如 xˉ; **population parameter 总体参数**描述整个总体, 例如未知的 μ.

显著性检验用前者对后者作推断, 而不是把样本均值直接当成总体均值. 样本变化时统计量会变, 总体参数在模型中则是固定值.

例如抽到 10 人后, xˉ 可以精确算出, 但这并不让 μ 变成已知. 检验正是利用 xˉ 在重复抽样中的分布, 评价关于 μ 的假设.

原文笔误:draw conlusions 应为 draw conclusions. 意思不变.

正态数据与均值检验
Normal Data and Tests of Means

4 正态分布相关的常见检验
4 A gallery of common significance tests related to the normal distribution

Page 2

We will show a number of tests that all assume normal data. For completeness we will include the z and t tests we’ve already explored.

You shouldn’t try to memorize these tests. It is a hopeless task to memorize the tests given here and even more hopeless to memorize all the tests we’ve left out. Rather, your goal should be to be able to find the correct test when you need it. Pay attention to the types of hypotheses the tests are designed to distinguish and the assumptions about the data needed for the test to be valid. We will work through the details of these tests in class and on homework.

不必背完整菜单. 先判断研究问题与数据结构, 再查对应统计量和零分布, 才能把这些检验推广到其他场景.

Page 2

The null distributions for all of these tests are all related to the normal distribution by explicit formulas. We will not go into the details of these distributions or the arguments showing how they arise as the null distributions in our significance tests. However, the arguments are accessible to anyone who knows calculus and is interested in understanding them. Given the name of any distribution, you can easily look up the details of its construction and properties online. You can also use R to explore the distribution numerically and graphically.

这些零分布都能从正态样本的变换得到. 本课不要求推导, 但要知道零分布是计算临界值和 p 值的基础.

Page 2

When analyzing data with any of these tests one thing of key importance is to verify that the assumptions are true or at least approximately true. For example, you shouldn’t use a test that assumes the data is normal unless you’ve checked that the data is approximately normal.

The script class19.r contains examples of using R to run some of these tests. It is posted in our usual place for R code.

这些检验的零分布都可由正态分布推出. 选择时先看均值比较的结构、方差信息、独立或配对关系以及组内方差假设, 再检查独立性和近似正态性.

不必背完整菜单. 面对新检验, 能查清它的统计量和零分布, 并判断数据是否满足条件, 才是可迁移的能力.

同样, 知道 z,t,F,χ2 的名字并不够. 真正决定计算的是当前统计量服从哪一个分布、自由度是多少、拒绝域在哪一侧, 以及这些设定是否来自实验设计.

4.1 z 检验
4.1 z-test

Pages 2–3
  • Use: Test if the population mean equals a hypothesized mean.
  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​.
  • Assumptions: The data are independent normal samples: xi​∼N(μ,σ2) where μ is unknown, but σ is known.
  • H0​: For a specified μ0​, μ=μ0​.
  • HA​: Two-sided: μ=μ0​; one-sided-greater: μ>μ0​; one-sided-less: μ<μ0​.
  • Test statistic: z=σ/n​xˉ−μ0​​.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(z∣H0​) is the pdf of Z∼N(0,1).
  • p-value: Two-sided: p=P(∣Z∣>z)=2∗(1−pnorm(abs(z), 0, 1)); one-sided-greater: p=P(Z>z)=1−pnorm(z, 0, 1); one-sided-less: p=P(Z<z)=pnorm(z, 0, 1).
  • R code: There does not seem to be a single R function in the base R packages that runs a z-test. There are other packages you can install that have a z.test function. Of course, it is easy enough to get R to compute the z score and p-value. There is an example of this in class19.r.

**z-test z 检验**用于总体标准差 σ 已知的均值检验. 分母 σ/n​ 是样本均值的标准误, z 表示样本均值离 μ0​ 有多少个标准误.

双尾 p 值应为 P(∣Z∣≥∣z∣), 右尾为 P(Z≥z), 左尾为 P(Z≤z). 连续分布中严格大于与大于等于的概率相同.

标准误 σ/n​ 描述样本均值的波动, 不是单个观测的标准差 σ. 样本量越大, 均值分布越集中, 同样的均值差对应更大的 ∣z∣.

观测 z 为负时, 双尾仍要同时看 Z<z 与 Z>−z 两端, 所以公式里必须出现 ∣z∣, 不能只写右侧的 z.

R 的 `pnorm` 给左尾累计概率, 所以双尾可用 2(1−pnorm(∣z∣)), 右尾用 1−pnorm(z), 左尾直接用 pnorm(z). 代码中的 `abs(z)` 正是在执行双尾取绝对值这一步.

幻灯片小错:双尾公式印成 P(∣Z∣>z), 当观测 z<0 时不正确; 应为 P(∣Z∣>∣z∣). 同一页的 R 代码用了 abs(z), 代码是对的.

IQ 的右尾 z 检验
Example 2.

Page 3

We quickly reprise our example from the class 17 notes.

IQ is normally distributed in the population according to a N(100,152) distribution. We suspect that most MIT students have above average IQ so we frame the following hypotheses.

H0​=MIT student IQs are distributed identically to the general population=MIT IQ’s follow a N(100,152) distribution.
HA​=MIT student IQs tend to be higher than those of the general population=the average MIT student IQ is greater than 100.

Notice that HA​ is one-sided.

Suppose we test 9 students and find they have an average IQ of xˉ=112. Can we reject H0​ at a significance level α=0.05?

Solution: Our test statistic is

z=15/9​xˉ−100​=1536​=2.4.

The right-sided p-value is therefore

p=P(Z≥2.4)=1- pnorm(2.4,0,1)=0.0081975.

Since p≤α we reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis that MIT students have higher IQs on average.

这是右尾检验, 因为备择事先指定 μ>100. z=(112−100)/(15/3)=2.4, 右尾 p=0.0081975359, 所以在 0.05 水平拒绝 H0​.

结论针对所设抽样模型下的平均 IQ, 不是「大多数 MIT 学生都更聪明」, 也不是 HA​ 的后验概率超过 99%.

计算分三层: 单个学生在 H0​ 下服从 N(100,152); 9 人均值则服从 N(100,152/9), 标准误为 5; 观测均值 112 再标准化为 z=2.4.

备择只关心更高均值, 所以 p 值是 z=2.4 右侧的面积. 左尾不需要加入, 拒绝结论也不表示所有学生的个体 IQ 都超过 100.

4.2 单样本 t 检验
4.2 One-sample t-test of the mean

Pages 3–4
  • Use: Test if the population mean equals a hypothesized mean.
  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​.
  • Assumptions: The data are independent normal samples: xi​∼N(μ,σ2) where both μ and σ are unknown.
  • H0​: For a specified μ0​, μ=μ0​.
  • HA​: Two-sided: μ=μ0​; one-sided-greater: μ>μ0​; one-sided-less: μ<μ0​.
  • Test statistic: t=s/n​xˉ−μ0​​, where s2 is the sample variance: s2=n−11​∑i=1n​(xi​−xˉ)2.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(n−1). (Student t-distribution with n−1 degrees of freedom)
  • p-value: Two-sided: p=P(∣T∣>t)=2∗(1−pt(abs(t), n-1)); one-sided-greater: p=P(T>t)=1−pt(t, n-1); one-sided-less: p=P(T<t)=pt(t, n-1).

单样本 t 检验把已知的 σ 换成样本标准差 s. 标准化后多了一层估计不确定性, 所以零分布是自由度 n−1 的 Student t 分布.

计算顺序是先求 xˉ 与 s2, 再算 s/n​ 和 t. 双尾概率取观测统计量的绝对值, 单尾则按备择方向取尾.

因为 s 本身也随样本变化, 学生化均值比使用已知 σ 的标准化均值多一层不确定性. 小样本时 t 分布尾部更厚, 大样本时逐渐接近标准正态.

样本方差先求各观察与样本均值的平方差, 再除以 n−1. 这个 n−1 与零分布自由度一致; 换成 n 会改变统计量和后续尾概率.

Page 4
  • R code example: For data x=1,3,5,7,2 we can run a one-sample t-test with H0​: μ0​=2.5 using the R command: t.test(x, mu = 2.5, alternative="two.sided"). This will return a several pieces of information including the mean of the data, t-value and the two-sided p-value. See the help for this function for other argument settings.

Example 3. Look in the class 18 notes or slides for an example of this test. The class 19 example R code also gives an example.

单样本 t 检验把已知的 σ 换成样本标准差 s. 标准化后多了一层估计不确定性, 所以零分布是自由度 n−1 的 Student t 分布.

双尾概率同样取观测统计量的绝对值: P(∣T∣≥∣t∣). R 的 `pt` 给出左尾累计概率, 右尾则用 1−pt.

`t.test` 的 `mu` 是原假设均值, `alternative` 决定双尾或单尾. 输出中的 t 与 p 是频率派检验结果, 不是总体均值的后验分布, 也不是「原假设为真的概率」.

幻灯片小错:双尾公式 P(∣T∣>t) 应为 P(∣T∣>∣t∣). R 代码中的 abs(t) 已体现正确写法.

4.3.1 等方差双样本 t 检验
4.3.1 The case of equal variances

Pages 4–5

We start by describing the test assuming equal variances.

  • Use: Test if the population means from two populations differ by a hypothesized amount.
  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​ and y1​,y2​,…,ym​.
  • Assumptions: Both groups of data are independent normal samples: xi​∼N(μx​,σ2), yj​∼N(μy​,σ2), where both μx​ and μy​ are unknown and possibly different. The variance σ2 is unknown, but the same for both groups.
  • H0​: For a specified Δμ the difference of means μx​−μy​=Δμ.
  • HA​: Two-sided: μx​−μy​=Δμ; one-sided-greater: μx​−μy​>Δμ; one-sided-less: μx​−μy​<Δμ.

等方差版本要求两组都正态且独立, 并共享同一个未知方差 σ2. 原假设可以直接写均值差 μx​−μy​=Δμ, 不一定非得是 0.

Page 5
  • Test statistic: t=sP​xˉ−yˉ​−Δμ​, where sx2​ and sy2​ are the sample variances of the x and y data respectively, and sP2​ is (sometimes called) the pooled sample variance:
    sP2​=n+m−2(n−1)sx2​+(m−1)sy2​​(n1​+m1​),df=n+m−2.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(df), the t-distribution with df=n+m−2 degrees of freedom.
  • p-value: Two-sided: p=P(∣T∣>t)=2∗(1−pt(abs(t), df)); one-sided-greater: p=P(T>t)=1−pt(t, df); one-sided-less: p=P(T<t)=pt(t, df).

分子用「观测均值差 − 假设均值差」, 分母是该差的标准误. 合并方差按两组自由度加权, 本讲记号的 sP2​ 已包含 (1/n+1/m).

每组各用一个自由度估计本组均值, 所以总自由度为 n+m−2. 双尾概率应写 P(∣T∣>∣t∣).

本讲把 sP2​ 定义为已经乘上 (1/n+1/m) 的均值差方差估计, 所以分母直接是 sP​. 若教材把合并总体方差也记为 sP2​, 则分母常写成 sP​1/n+1/m​, 两种写法不要重复乘因子.

Page 5
  • R code: The R function t.test will run a two-sample t-test. See the example code in class19.r. In t.test the argument mu is used for what we have called Δμ.

Notes: 1. Most often the test is done with Δμ=0. That is, the null hypothesis is the the means are equal, i.e. μx​−μy​=0.

2. If the x and y data have the same length n=m, then the formula for sP2​ becomes simpler: sP2​=(sx2​+sy2​)/n.

Example 4. Look in the class 18 notes or slides for an example of the two-sample t-test.

等方差双样本 t 检验把两组信息合并估计共同方差. 分子比较「观测均值差」与「零假设均值差」, 分母是这个均值差的标准误.

每组各损失一个估计均值的自由度, 所以 df=n+m−2. 通常 Δμ=0, 双尾概率应写 P(∣T∣>∣t∣), 与前面的修正相同.

当 n=m 时, 合并公式会化简为 (sx2​+sy2​)/n. 这只是代数简化, 两组仍必须满足等方差与独立正态假设, 样本量相同本身不是使用配对检验的理由.

4.3.2 不等方差: Welch t 检验
4.3.2 The case of unequal variances

Pages 5–6

There is a form of the t-test for when the variances are not assumed equal. It is sometimes called Welch’s t-test.

This looks exactly the same as the case of equal except for a small change in the assumptions and the formula for the pooled variance:

  • Use: Test if the population means from two populations differ by a hypothesized amount.
  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​ and y1​,y2​,…,ym​.
  • Assumptions: Both groups of data are independent normal samples: xi​∼N(μx​,σx2​), yj​∼N(μy​,σy2​), where both μx​ and μy​ are unknown and possibly different. The variances σx2​ and σy2​ are unknown and not assumed to be equal.
  • H0​,HA​: Exactly the same as the case of equal variances.

Welch 版本仍要求两组独立正态, 但允许两组方差不同. 原假设和备择的形式与等方差版本完全相同, 改变的是标准误与自由度估计.

Page 6
  • Test statistic: t=sP​xˉ−yˉ​−Δμ​, where sx2​ and sy2​ are the sample variances of the x and y data respectively, and sP2​ is (sometimes called) the pooled sample variance:
    sP2​=nsx2​​+msy2​​,df=(sx2​/n)2/(n−1)+(sy2​/m)2/(m−1)(sx2​/n+sy2​/m)2​.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(df), the t distribution with df degrees of freedom.
  • p-value: Exactly the same as the case of equal variances.
  • R code: The function t.test also handles this case if you set the argument var.equal=FALSE.

Welch 的标准误直接把 sx2​/n 与 sy2​/m 相加, 不先合并成一个共同方差. 自由度再用 Welch–Satterthwaite 公式近似, 所以经常不是整数.

R 中 `var.equal=FALSE` 选择这个版本. 它的 t 零分布也是近似, 不是严格精确分布.

近似自由度会随两组方差和样本量变化, 方差差异越大、样本越不均衡, 与等方差公式的差别越值得关注. 不确定是否该假定等方差时, Welch 通常更稳妥.

Page 6

Notes. 1. In truth, the null distribution given above only approximates the exact null distribution.

2. Notice that the degrees of freedom are unlikely to be a whole number.

3. Some people recommend always using Welch’s t-test, even if the variances are believed to be equal. This avoids making the assumption that the variances are equal and has very little downside if they are equal.

这三条说明 Welch 的自由度是近似计算结果, 不必强行四舍五入成整数. 软件可以直接用这个自由度计算尾概率.

即使两组方差看起来相等, 使用 Welch 也不会带来太大代价; 它减少了额外假设, 但仍要求独立性和近似正态性.

4.3.3 配对双样本 t 检验
4.3.3 The paired two-sample t-test

Pages 6–7

When the data naturally comes in pairs (xi​,yi​), we can use the paired two-sample t-test. (After checking the assumptions are valid!)

Example 5. To measure the effectiveness of a cholesterol lowering medication we might test each subject before and after treatment with the drug. So for each subject we have a pair of measurements: xi​= cholesterol level before treatment, yi​= cholesterol level after treatment.

Example 6. To measure the effectiveness of a cancer treatment we might pair each subject who received the treatment with one who did not. In this case we would want to pair subjects who are similar in terms of stage of the disease, age, sex, etc.

配对可以来自同一人前后测量, 也可以来自按病情、年龄等特征事先匹配的两个个体. 配对的目标是消除对内共同差异.

两组样本量相同并不自动构成配对, 必须知道每个 xi​ 与哪个 yi​ 是一对.

Pages 6–7
  • Use: Test if the average difference between paired values in a population equals a hypothesized value.
  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​ and y1​,y2​,…,yn​ must have the same length.
  • Assumptions: The differences wi​=xi​−yi​ between the paired samples are independent draws from a normal distribution N(μ,σ2), where μ and σ are unknown.
  • H0​: For a specified μ0​, μ=μ0​.
  • HA​: Two-sided: μ=μ0​; one-sided-greater: μ>μ0​; one-sided-less: μ<μ0​.
  • Test statistic: t=s/n​wˉ−μ0​​, where s2 is the sample variance: s2=n−11​∑i=1n​(wi​−wˉ)2.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(n−1). (Student t-distribution with n−1 degrees of freedom)
  • p-value: Two-sided: p=P(∣T∣>t)=2∗(1−pt(abs(t), n-1)); one-sided-greater: p=P(T>t)=1−pt(t, n-1); one-sided-less: p=P(T<t)=pt(t, n-1).
  • R code: The R function t.test will do a paired two-sample test if you set the argument paired=TRUE. You can also run a one-sample t-test on x−y. There are examples of both of these in class19.r

先对每对求差 wi​=xi​−yi​, 再对差值做单样本 t 检验. 正态性要求作用于差值, 独立性要求作用于不同对之间; 同一对内的 xi​,yi​ 不必独立.

R 的 `paired=TRUE` 与直接对 x−y 做单样本检验等价, 双尾概率仍取 ∣t∣.

差值方向一旦确定, 均值差的符号和备择方向都要跟随. 若用「后 − 前」, 正值表示增加; 若改用「前 − 后」, 同一变化的符号就反过来. 解释结果时先回到差值定义.

Page 7

Notes. 1. This is just a one-sample t-test using wi​.

2. Another way to write the assumption is that we assume a relation between xi​ and yi​ of the form yi​=xi​+μ+e. Here μ is some (unknown) constant, and e is random error (noise) of mean 0 and (unknown) variance σ2.

**paired t-test 配对 t 检验**先对每对求差 wi​=xi​−yi​, 再对差值做单样本 t 检验. 正态性要求作用于差值, 独立性要求作用于不同对之间; 同一对内的 xi​,yi​ 不必独立.

配对能消除对内共同差异, 例如同一人治疗前后的基线差. 关键是数据必须真有配对结构, 不能仅因两组样本量相同就配对.

Note 2 的模型式必须与差值定义一起读. 若 wi​=xi​−yi​ 且 wi​ 的均值为 μ, 则应写 yi​=xi​−μ+e; 若坚持 yi​=xi​+μ+e, 那么应把差值改为 yi​−xi​.

幻灯片前后不一致:前文定义 wi​=xi​−yi​ 且 E[wi​]=μ, Note 2 却写 yi​=xi​+μ+e, 这会给 wi​ 的均值 −μ. 保持前文符号时应写 yi​=xi​−μ+e; 或把差值改定义为 yi​−xi​.

吸烟与血小板聚集
Example 7.

Pages 7–8

The following example is taken from Rice.

To study the effect of cigarette smoking on platelet aggregation Levine (1973) drew blood samples from 11 subjects before and after they smoked a cigarette and measured the extent to which platelets aggregated. Here is the data:

Before2525274430675353526028
After2729375646825780615943
Difference24101216154279-115

The null hypothesis is that smoking had no effect on platelet aggregation, i.e. that the difference between before and after should have mean μ0​=0. We ran a paired two-sample t-test to test this hypothesis. Here is the R code: (It’s also in class19.r.)

before.cig = c(25,25,27,44,30,67,53,53,52,60,28)
after.cig = c(27,29,37,56,46,82,57,80,61,59,43)
mu0 = 0
result = t.test(after.cig, before.cig, alternative="two.sided", mu=mu0, paired=TRUE)
print(result)

代码使用「吸烟后 − 吸烟前」的配对差值, 检验平均差是否为 0. 这与先逐人求差再做单样本 t 检验完全等价.

Page 8

Here is the output:

Paired t-test
data: after.cig and before.cig
t = 4.2716, df = 10, p-value = 0.001633
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means is not equal to 0
mean of the differences: 10.27273

We got the same results with the one-sample t-test: t.test(after.cig - before.cig, mu=0)

这里差值定义为「吸烟后 − 吸烟前」, 平均差为 10.27273. Python 独立计算得 t=4.2716088, df=10, 双尾 p=0.00163285, 与原文输出一致.

在模型假设成立时, 数据支持拒绝「平均差为 0」. 但观察性前后比较本身不能排除所有同时发生的因素, 统计显著不自动等于完整因果证明.

计算时先得到 11 个差值, 平均为 10.27273; 再求这些差值的样本方差与均值标准误, 得到 t=4.2716. 自由度是 11−1=10, 双尾则同时累计两侧比 ∣t∣ 更远的概率.

配对设计消除了每个人自身的基线差异, 但「吸烟前后」还可能伴随时间、测量环境或其他共同变化, 所以因果解释仍需谨慎.

单因素方差分析
One-way ANOVA

4.4 单因素方差分析
4.4 One-way ANOVA (F-test for equal means)

Pages 8–9
  • Use: Test if the population means from n groups are all the same.
  • Data: (n groups, m samples from each group) xi,j​, i=1,…,n, j=1,…,m.
  • Assumptions: Data for each group is an independent normal sample drawn from distributions with (possibly) different means but the same variance: xi,j​∼N(μi​,σ2). The group means μi​ are unknown and possibly different. The variance σ is unknown, but the same for all groups.
  • H0​: All the means are identical μ1​=μ2​=⋯=μn​.
  • HA​: Not all the means are the same.

单因素方差分析同时比较 n 个组. 各组独立、近似正态、方差相同, 但总体均值可以不同.

H0​ 要求所有均值全相等, HA​ 只要求至少一个不同. 它不是分别检验每一个两两比较.

Page 8
  • Test statistic: f=MSB​/MSW​, where
    xˉi​=mxi,1​+xi,2​+⋯+xi,m​​,xˉ=grand mean of all the data,
    si2​=m−11​j=1∑m​(xi,j​−xˉi​)2,
    MSB​=between group variance=m×sample variance of group means=n−1m​i=1∑n​(xˉi​−xˉ)2,
    MSW​=average within group variance=sample mean of s12​,…,sn2​=ns12​+s22​+⋯+sn2​​.

MSB​ 先看每组均值, 再看它们围绕总均值的分散程度, 并乘每组样本量 m. MSW​ 则对各组内部方差取平均.

因此分子描述组间差异, 分母描述组内噪声. 后面的 F 统计量就是这两类变异的比.

组均值若彼此接近, MSB​ 只剩抽样波动; 若某些组均值明显分开, MSB​ 会额外包含真实的组间效应. MSW​ 不受这种均值分离的直接影响, 仍主要反映组内噪声.

Pages 8–9
  • Idea: If the μi​ are all equal, test statistic f, which is a ratio, should be near 1. If they are not equal then MSB​ should be larger while MSW​ should remain about the same, so f should be larger. We won’t give a proof of this.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(f∣H0​) is the pdf of F∼F(n−1,n(m−1)). This is the F-distribution with (n−1) and n(m−1) degrees of freedom. Several F-distributions are plotted below.
  • p-value: p=P(F>f)=1−pf(f, n-1, n*(m-1)))

若所有总体均值相同, MSB​ 与 MSW​ 都估计共同方差, 比值通常接近 1; 若组均值不同, 分子倾向变大, 所以使用右尾.

两个自由度依次是组间 n−1 和组内 n(m−1). 显著结果只说并非所有均值相同, 不指出具体哪几组不同.

Page 9

Notes: 1. ANOVA tests whether all the means are the same. It does not test whether some subset of the means are the same.

2. There is a test where the variances are not assumed equal.

3. There is a test where the groups don’t all have the same number of samples.

4. R has a function aov() to run ANOVA tests.

5. See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F-test

**one-way ANOVA 单因素方差分析**同时比较 n 个组的均值. MSB​ 衡量组均值之间的变异, MSW​ 衡量组内随机变异.

若所有总体均值相同, 两者都估计共同的 σ2, 比值通常接近 1; 若组均值不同, MSB​ 会增大. 检验只看右尾, 因为备择使 F 偏大.

「接近 1」是零假设下的典型趋势, 不是每次都必须大于 1. 即使 H0​ 为真, 抽样波动也可能让 F 小于 1; 关键是异常大的比值是否罕见.

零分布的两个自由度依次是 n−1 和 n(m−1). 显著结果只说「并非所有均值都相同」, 不指出具体哪几组不同.

拒绝可以用两种等价方式判断: F 超过对应自由度的临界值, 或右尾 p 小于预设 α. 若要知道哪些组不同, 还需另做事后比较并处理多重检验.

原文笔误:R 表达式 1- pf(f, n-1, n*(m-1))) 末尾多一个右括号. 应为 1 - pf(f, n-1, n*(m-1)).

Page 9; Slide 12

F-distribution

  • Notation: Fa,b​, a and b degrees of freedom
  • Derived from normal data
  • Range: [0,∞)
  • mean ≈1

读图:F 分布非负且右偏. 不同自由度会改变峰的位置和右尾形状, 所以临界值必须同时按两个自由度查.

「均值约 1」是便于理解比值的概括. 更精确地说, Fa,b​ 在 b>2 时均值为 b/(b−2).

由于 F 是两个均方之比, 取值不可能为负. 备择使比值偏大时, 极端区域也就在右尾; 查表或软件时必须同时提供分子和分母两个自由度.

三种处理的疼痛等级
Example 8.

Pages 9–10

The table shows patients’ perceived level of pain (on a scale of 1 to 6) after 3 different medical procedures.

T1​T2​T3​
232
441
163
513
345

(1) Set up and run an F-test comparing the means of these 3 treatments.

(2) Based on the test, what might you conclude about the treatments?

Solution: Using the code below, the F statistic is 0.325 and the p-value is 0.729 At any reasonable significance level we will fail to reject the null hypothesis that the average pain level is the same for all three treatments..

Note, it is not reasonable to conclude the the null hypothesis is true. With just 5 data points per procedure we might simply lack the power to distinguish different means.

# DATA ----
T1 = c(2,4,1,5,3)
T2 = c(3,4,6,1,4)
T3 = c(2,1,3,3,5)
procedure = c(rep('T1',length(T1)),rep('T2',length(T2)),rep('T3',length(T3)))
pain = c(T1,T2,T3)
data.pain = data.frame(procedure,pain)
aov.data = aov(pain~procedure,data=data.pain) # do the analysis of variance
print(summary(aov.data)) # show the summary table
# class19.r also shows code to compute the ANOVA by hand.

The summary shows a p-value (shown as Pr(>F)) of 0.729. Therefore we do not reject the null hypothesis that all three group population means are the same.

三组均值是 3、3.6、2.8, 总均值 3.13333. Python 算得 MSB​=0.86667, MSW​=2.66667, F=0.325, 自由度 (2,12), p=0.7286925, 与原文一致.

不拒绝三种处理的平均疼痛水平相同, 但不能据此证明三者完全相同. 每组只有 5 个观测, 功效可能不足; 疼痛等级是否近似满足正态和等方差假设也应检查.

这里 F=0.325 很小, 表示组间变异相对组内变异不大. 但这只是当前样本的证据, 不是三种处理效应在全总体中严格相等的证明.

恢复时间课堂题
Board question: Recovery

Slide 14

The table shows recovery time in days for three medical treatments.

(a) Set up and run an F-test testing if the average recovery time is the same for all three treatments. Use significance level 0.05.

(b) Based on the test, what might you conclude about the treatments?

T1​T2​T3​
6813
8129
4911
5118
367
4812

Note: For α=0.05, the critical value of F2,15​ is 3.68.

设 H0​:μ1​=μ2​=μ3​, HA​ 为三者不全相同. 假定各组恢复时间独立、近似正态且方差相同. 三组均值为 5、9、10, 总均值为 8, 所以

MSB​=3−16​((5−8)2+(9−8)2+(10−8)2)=42,MSW​=33.2+4.8+5.6​=4.53333.

因此 F=42/4.53333=9.26471, 自由度为 (2,15), 大于临界值 3.68; Python 算得 p=0.00239878. 在 0.05 水平拒绝 H0​, 但此检验没有指出哪些组不同.

组间计算先把三组均值 5、9、10 与总均值 8 比较, 得到平方差 9、1、4; 求和后乘每组 6 人再除以组间自由度 2, 得 MSB​=42.

组内则分别计算三组的样本方差 3.2、4.8、5.6, 再平均得 MSW​=4.53333. 组间差异约为组内噪声的 9.26 倍, 所以拒绝「全部均值相同」.

多重检验概念题
Concept question: multiple-testing

Slide 15

(a) Suppose we have 6 treatments and want to know if the average recovery time is the same for all of them. If we compare two at a time, how many two-sample t-tests do we need to run?

(i) 1   (ii) 2   (iii) 6   (iv) 15   (v) 30

(b) Suppose we use the significance level 0.05 for each of the 15 tests. Assuming the null hypothesis, what is the best estimate of the probability that we reject at least one of the 15 null hypotheses?

(i) <0.05   (ii) 0.05   (iii) 0.10   (iv) >0.25

(a) 选 (iv) 15. 每对处理比较一次, 共 (26​)=15 对.

(b) 选 (iv) >0.25. 每次检验的 0.05 不能保证整组错误率仍是 0.05. 各比较共享数据, 并不独立, 所以不能直接套 1−0.9515; 教师计划中的 R 模拟给出约 0.36, 本机未运行这段 R.

「至少一次误拒」是 15 个误拒事件的并集. 检验越多, 并集发生的机会通常越大, 即使每次单独检验都严格控制在自己的 0.05 水平.

共享处理组会让这些事件相关, 因此独立公式既不能作为精确答案, 也不能替代这里的模拟估计.

ANOVA 与多次两两检验
Discussion

Slide 16

Recall that there is an F-test that tests if all the means are the same. What are the trade-offs of using the F-test rather than many two-sample t-tests?

The advantage of the F-test is that it is a single test. So, there is no need to adjust the significance of multiple tests to achieve the correct overall significance. The disadvantage it that it only tests if all the means are the same. It does not say which pairs are different.

一次 ANOVA 把「所有均值是否相同」作为一个检验, 避免反复两两检验造成第一类错误累积. 代价是结论较粗: 显著后仍需做事后两两比较, 并进行多重检验校正.

例如 **Bonferroni correction Bonferroni 校正**把每次比较的水平设为 0.05/15=0.00333, 可将整组第一类错误率控制在 0.05 以下, 但会降低功效.

Bonferroni 不需要各检验相互独立, 因为它用并集概率的上界控制「至少一次误拒」. 代价是每次比较更严格, 真实差异更容易被漏掉, 所以通常先做整体 F 检验再决定后续比较.

卡方拟合优度检验
Chi-square Test for Goodness of Fit

4.5 卡方拟合优度检验
4.5 Chi-square test for goodness of fit

Pages 10–11

This is a test of how well a hypothesized probability distribution fits a set of data. The test statistic is called a chi-square statistic and the null distribution associated to the chi-square statistic is the chi-square distribution. It is denoted by χ2(df) where the parameter df is called the degrees of freedom.

Suppose we have an unknown probability mass function given by the following table.

Outcomesω1​ω2​…ωn​
Probabilitiesp1​p2​…pn​

In the chi-square test for goodness of fit we hypothesize a set of values for the probabilities. Typically we will hypothesize that the probabilities follow a known distribution with certain parameters, e.g. binomial, Poisson, multinomial. The test then tries to determine if this set of probabilities could reasonably have generated the data we collected.

拟合优度检验先由 H0​ 给出各类别的概率, 再看观察频数是否像由这组概率产生. 它适用于离散的类别计数, 不要求原始数据正态.

Page 10
  • Use: Test whether discrete data fits a specific finite probability mass function.
  • Data: An observed count Oi​ for each possible outcome ωi​.
  • Assumptions: None
  • H0​: The data was drawn from a specific discrete distribution.
  • HA​: The data was drawn from a different distribution.
  • Test statistic: The data consists of observed counts Oi​ for each ωi​. From the null hypothesis probability table we get a set of expected counts Ei​. There are two statistics that we can use:
    G=2i∑​Oi​ln(Oi​/Ei​),X2=i∑​Ei​(Oi​−Ei​)2​.
    It is a theorem that under the null hypothesis X2≈G and both are approximately chi-square. Before computers, X2 was used because it was easier to compute. Now, it is better to use G although you will still see X2 used quite often.

Pearson 统计量 X2 把每格的 (Oi​−Ei​)2/Ei​ 相加; 似然比统计量 G 用 Oi​ln(Oi​/Ei​) 衡量偏离. 两者大值都表示拟合差, 因而用右尾.

除以 Ei​ 让 Pearson 各项按期望规模标准化, 平方避免正负差抵消. G 与 X2 在零假设下通常接近, 但小样本或小期望频数时可能不同.

选择哪一种统计量应在看结果前决定, 不能分别算出后挑更容易显著的一个. 若 Oi​=0, 对应 G 项按 Oi​ln(Oi​/Ei​)=0 的极限理解.

两类统计量比较的不是观察值是否等于期望值, 而是整个偏离是否超过零模型下的随机波动. 小统计量通常表示拟合好, 大统计量才进入右尾拒绝域.

Pages 10–11
  • Degrees of freedom df: For chi-square tests the number of degrees of freedom can be a bit tricky. In this case df=n−1. It is computed as the number of cell counts that can be freely set under HA​ consistent with the statistics needed to compute the expected cell counts assuming H0​.
  • Null distribution: Assuming H0​, both statistics (approximately) follow a chi-square distribution with df degrees of freedom. That is both ϕ(G∣H0​) and ϕ(X2∣H0​) have (approximately) the same pdf as Y∼χ2(df).

自由度按「能自由设置的格数」计算. 只固定总频数时, n 格中有 n−1 个自由; 如果还由数据估计参数, 通常要再减去相应约束数.

两种统计量在 H0​ 下都只是近似服从 χ2(df), 期望频数太小时近似可能不可靠.

拒绝域放在右侧, 是因为统计量越大, 观察频数与零模型的偏离越严重. 很小的统计量表示拟合较好, 不应被当成反对 H0​ 的证据.

Page 11
  • p-value: Extreme data means large values of X2, i.e. large differences between the observed and expected counts. So, p=P(Y>G)=1−pchisq(G, df) and p=P(Y>X2)=1−pchisq(X2,df).
  • R code: The R function chisq.test can be used to do the computations for a chi-square test use X2. For G you either have to do it by hand or find a package that has a function. (It will probably be called likelihood.test or G.test.

Notes. 1. When the likelihood ratio statistic G is used the test is also called a G-test or a likelihood ratio test.

**chi-square goodness-of-fit test 卡方拟合优度检验**比较观测频数 Oi​ 与零假设下的期望频数 Ei​. Pearson 统计量 X2 累加标准化平方差; **likelihood ratio statistic 似然比统计量** G 用对数衡量偏离.

两者大值都说明观测与模型不合, 所以用右尾. 自由度不是固定背 n−1: 每用数据估计一个额外约束, 通常再减 1.

幻灯片小错:Assumptions: None 过于绝对. 它只能理解为不要求原始数据服从正态分布; 检验仍需合适的随机抽样与计数结构, 使用卡方零分布作近似时还要求期望频数不太小.

第一个卡方例
Example 9. First chi-square example.

Page 11

Suppose we have an experiment that produces numerical data. For this experiment the possible outcomes are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or more. We run 51 trials and count the frequency of each outcome, getting the following data:

Outcomes01234≥5
Observed counts310151373

Suppose our null hypothesis H0​ is that the data is drawn from 51 trials of a binomial(8, 0.5) distribution and our alternative hypothesis HA​ is that the data is drawn from some other distribution. Do all of the following:

  1. Make a table of the observed and expected counts.
  2. Compute both the likelihood ratio statistic G and Pearson’s chi-square statistic X2.
  3. Compute the degrees of freedom of the null distribution.
  4. Compute the p-values corresponding to G and X2.

题目指定 Binomial(8,0.5) 为零模型, 共观察 51 次. 要先算每类概率与期望频数, 再分别计算 G,X2, 自由度和右尾概率.

Page 11

Solution: All of the R code used for this example is in class19.r.

1. Assuming H0​ the data truly comes from a binomial(8, 0.5) distribution. We have 51 total observations, so the expected count for each outcome is just 51 times its probability. We computed the binomial(8, 0.5) probabilities and expected counts in R:

Outcomes01234≥5
Observed counts310151373
H0​ probabilities0.00390.03130.10940.21880.27340.3633
Expected counts0.201.595.5811.1613.9518.53

2. Using the formulas above we compute that X2=116.41 and G=66.08

3. The only statistic used in computing the expected counts was the total number of observations 51. So, the degrees of freedom is 5, i.e we can set 5 of the cell counts freely and the last is determined by requiring that the total number is 51.

4. The p-values are pG​=1−pchisq(G, 5) and pX2​=1−pchisq(X2,5). Both p-values are effectively 0. For almost any significance level we would reject H0​ in favor of HA​.

Python 核对得 X2=116.40566, G=66.08123, df=5; 对应右尾概率分别约 1.81×10−23 和 6.69×10−13. 两者都强烈拒绝这个二项模型.

前两个期望频数只有 0.20 和 1.59, 卡方近似的精度值得警惕. 这里统计量和偏离都很大, 拒绝结论仍清楚, 但不应把近似 p 值的许多小数位当成精确概率.

自由度为 5 是因为有 6 个类别, 而计算期望频数只用了总观察数 51 这一约束. 任意选定 5 格后, 最后一格就被总数唯一确定.

期望频数由 51 乘各类别的零模型概率得到, 而不是把观察频数当作概率再重复估计. 观测与期望在高低计数类别上的巨大差距, 是统计量很大的直接原因.

4.5.1 卡方检验的自由度
4.5.1 Degrees of freedom in chi-square tests

Pages 11–12

We alreay gave a quick definition of degrees of freedom for a chi-square test. Here we will try to go a little slower in showing how to compute degrees of freedom.

To start, recall that in a chi-square test, our table has n observed counts. Then, we use observed counts and the null hypothesis to compute n expected counts. This is typically done by computing some statistics and using them estimate the parameters needed to compute the expected counts. For example, in the previous example the statistic computed was the total number of counts.

Now, imagine that we are allowed to fabricate the n observed counts, but we demand that our made up observations produce the same statistics as the true observed counts. That is, our imaginary observed counts need to produce the same expected counts as the true data.

The degrees of freedom is the number of fake observed counts we can freely choose. The rest will be determined by our constraint that they produce the same statistics.

把每个单元格看成一个坐标. 固定总频数、固定样本均值或固定边际总数, 都相当于增加约束. 能自由选择的单元格数就是自由度: 「单元格数 − 独立约束数」.

这里「虚构计数」只是帮助数约束的思想实验. 约束必须来自计算期望频数时实际使用的统计量, 不能看到表格就机械减 1.

例如固定总数时, 最后一格由其他格推出; 再固定样本均值时, 又会多一个方程把另一格联系起来. 剩下的自由坐标数才是卡方分布的自由度.

估计参数后的自由度
Example 10. (Degrees of freedom.)

Page 12

Suppose we have the following observed counts

Outcomes012345
Observed counts69131273

Suppose our null hypothesis H0​ is that the data producing these counts was drawn from 50 trials of a binomial(5, θ) distribution. Our alternative hypothesis HA​ is that the data is drawn from some other distribution. Run a chi-square test of these hypotheses with significance 0.05.

Solution: To compute expected counts we need a value of θ. Since it is not known, we have to use the data to estimate it.

The total number of observations is 50. So, the mean of the data is

m=506⋅0+9⋅1+13⋅2+12⋅3+7⋅4+3⋅5​=2.28.

The expected value of a binom(5,θ) distribution, is 5θ. The maximum likelihood estimate for θ is θ^=m/5=0.456.

Now, just like in the previous example, we can compute expected counts for each possible outcome. The expected count of outcome k is 50⋅p(k). In R this is 50*dbinom(k, 50, \(\hat\theta\)). We have the following table

Outcomes012345
Observed counts69131273
Expected counts2.389.9816.7414.035.880.99

先由样本均值 m=2.28 估计 θ^=m/5=0.456, 再用 Binomial(5,θ^) 的概率乘 50 得到期望频数.

这里 H0​ 没有预先指定 θ, 所以参数估计会增加一个约束, 直接影响后面的自由度.

为什么多减 1? 因为虚构其他计数时, 不只要求总数仍为 50, 还要求样本均值仍为 2.28, 才能给出同一个 θ^ 和同一组期望频数. 能自由改变的格子因此只剩 4 个.

若 H0​ 事先给定 θ=0.456, 就不需要从数据估计它, 只剩总频数一个约束. 本例则是先估参数再算期望, 所以自由度比完全指定模型的情形少 1.

这也说明自由度由整个拟合过程决定, 而不是只看表格有几行几列.

Page 12

To determine the degrees of freedom:

(i) We have 6 observed counts.

(ii) To compute the expected counts we need the total number of counts = 50 and our estimate of θ^=m/5 That is, we have two constraints: the total number of counts is 50, and mean m=2.28.

So, to get the same expected counts, we could choose 4 of the observed counts freely and then set last two counts so the constraints are met. Thus, there are 4 degrees of freedom.

More briefly: 6 observed counts - 2 constraints = 4 degrees of freedom.

Using R we can compute G=8.01, with p-value 0.09. Thus, at significance level 0.05 we would not reject the null hypothesis.

Note, the X2 statistic is 11.05 with p-value 0.026. Clearly this example is a borderline case, since we reject H0​ when using X2 and we don’t when using G.

It bears repeating, for reasons like this, we never say H0​ is false. The most we can say is that the data does not support rejecting H0​.

估计 θ^=2.28/5=0.456 用到了数据, 所以除总频数外又多一个约束, df=6−2=4. Python 核对得 G=8.01353,pG​=0.09108; X2=11.04864,pX2​=0.02602.

同一数据在 0.05 水平给出不同决定, 说明结果处于边界且小期望频数下的近似可能不稳定. 应在看结果前选定统计量, 不能挑能显著的那一个.

这里 G 的 p 值约 0.091, X2 的 p 值约 0.026, 分居 0.05 两侧. 这不是数学矛盾, 而是两个统计量及其卡方近似对这份数据的反应不同.

遇到这种边界结果, 应如实报告方法和近似限制, 不要把其中一次结果包装成确定的真假结论.

幻灯片错误:R 代码 50*dbinom(k, 50, \(\hat\theta\)) 把二项分布的试验次数写成了 50. 本例是 binomial(5,θ), 应为 50*dbinom(k, 5, \(\hat\theta\)); 前面的 50 是观测总数.

原文结论方向写反:本例用 X2 时会拒绝 H0​, 用 G 时不拒绝. 正确说法是: 检验不能证明 H0​ 确定真或假; 不拒绝时只能说「数据不支持拒绝 H0​」, 拒绝时则说「数据支持拒绝 H0​」. 原文把「不拒绝」的结论写成了所有情形的上限.

孟德尔遗传实验
Example 11. Mendel’s genetic experiments

Pages 13–14

In one of his experiments on peas Mendel looked at 2 genetic trait pairs: smooth/wrinkled and yellow/green. Symbolically we label a smooth gene S and a wrinkled gene s. Likewise we use Y and y for yellow and green respectively.

Mendel started by selecting a parent generation of homozygous plants. They were either smooth/yellow (genes SSYY) and wrinkled/green (genes ssyy). He crossed the smooth/yellow with the wrinkled/green peas creating the, so called, F1​ generation consisting of plants with genes SsYy. Since smooth (S) and yellow Y are both dominant traits, all these plants were smooth/yellow.

He then crossed 556 pairs of the F1​ generation to create the F2​ generation. We would expect 1/4 of the F2​ generation to have two smooth genes (SS), 1/4 to have two wrinkled genes (ss), and the remaining 1/2 to be heterozygous (Ss). We also expect these fractions for yellow (Y) and green (y) genes. If the color and smoothness genes are inherited independently and smooth and yellow are both dominant we’d expect the following table of frequencies for phenotypes.

YellowGreen
Smooth9/163/163/4
Wrinkled3/161/161/4
3/41/41

Probability table for the null hypothesis

亲本为 SSYY 与 ssyy, F1​ 都是 SsYy. 两对基因独立分配且 S,Y 为显性时, F2​ 的表型比例为 9:3:3:1.

其中双显性 smooth yellow 占 9/16, 单显性各占 3/16, 双隐性 wrinkled green 占 1/16. 这四类正好对应后面的四个计数格.

Page 13

So from the 556 crosses the expected number of smooth yellow peas is 556×9/16=312.75. Likewise for the other possibilities. Here is a table giving the observed and expected counts from Mendel’s experiments.

Observed countExpected count
Smooth yellow315312.75
Smooth green108104.25
Wrinkled yellow102104.25
Wrinkled green3134.75

独立分配且两种性状均为显性时, 表型比例是 9:3:3:1. 乘总数 556 就得到四个期望频数, 观察值则非常接近这些数.

比例完全由零模型给出, 没有另估参数, 所以后面只需考虑总频数这一约束.

Pages 13–14

The null hypothesis is that the observed counts are random samples distributed according to the frequency table given above. We use the counts to compute our statistics

The likelihood ratio statistic is

G=2i∑​Oi​ln(Oi​/Ei​)=2(315ln412.75315​+108ln104.25108​+102ln104.25102​+31ln34.7531​)=0.618.

Pearson’s chi-square statistic is

X2=i∑​Ei​(Oi​−Ei​)2​=312.752.752​+104.253.752​+104.252.252​+34.753.752​=0.604.

You can see that the two statistics are very close. This is usually the case. In general the likelihood ratio statistic is more robust and should be preferred.

The degrees of freedom is 3, because there are 4 observed quantities and one relation between them, i.e. they sum to 556. So, under the null hypothesis G follows a χ2(3) distribution.

Using R to compute the p-value we get

p=1−pchisq(0.618, 3)=0.8923.

Assuming the null hypothesis we would see data at least this extreme almost 90% of the time. We would not reject the null hypothesis for any reasonable significance level.

The p-value using Pearson’s statistic is 0.8955 –nearly identical.

The script class19.r shows these calculations and also how to use chisq.test to run a chi-square test directly.

独立遗传且两种性状均为显性时, 表型比例是 9:3:3:1. 四个比例完全由模型给出, 唯一约束是总数 556, 因而 df=4−1=3.

Python 核对得 G=0.618439,pG​=0.892198, X2=0.604317,pX2​=0.895443. 观测频数很接近期望频数, 两种统计量都不拒绝独立遗传模型.

两个 p 值接近 0.9, 表示在独立模型下, 得到至少这么极端的计数非常常见. 这支持模型与数据相容, 但仍不是对独立遗传的绝对证明.

计算时四个差值分别是 2.25,3.75,−2.25,−3.75, 平方后符号消失, 再按各格期望频数加权求和. 红框中的分母与第一项平方是排版笔误, 最终 0.604 与 0.618 则按正确项得到.

原文笔误:G 展开式第一项的分母印成 412.75, 应为 312.75; X2 第一项的分子印成 2.752, 应为 (315−312.75)2=2.252. 原文最后的数值用的是正确项.

总顾客数为 200, 期望频数为 (20,20,30,40,60,30). Python 算得 X2=11.44167, G=11.38654, df=6−1=5, 对应 pX2​=0.043293, pG​=0.044232.

若事先设 α=0.05, 两者都拒绝店主分布; 若事先设 α=0.01, 两者都不拒绝. 不能看完 p 值后再选择显著性水平.

星期一、星期二和星期六对 X2 的贡献较大, 说明观察分布与店主声称的差异主要集中在这些日子. 但题目只提供一周记录, 还应考虑星期效应和抽样波动.

遗传连锁课堂题
Board question: genetic linkage

Slide 11

In 1905, William Bateson, Edith Saunders, and Reginald Punnett were examining flower color and pollen shape in sweet pea plants by performing crosses similar to those carried out by Gregor Mendel.

  • Purple flowers (P) is dominant over red flowers (p).
  • Long seeds (L) is dominant over round seeds (l).
  • F0: PPLL x ppll (initial cross)
  • F1: PpLl x PpLl (all second generation plants were PpLl)
  • F2: 2132 plants (third generation)

H0​= independent assortment: color and shape are inherited independently.

Here is the data from their experiment.

purple, longpurple, roundred, longred, round
Expected????
Observed1528106117381

Determine the expected counts for F2 under H0​ and find the p-value for a Pearson chi-square test. Explain your findings biologically.

独立分配时表型比例仍为 9:3:3:1, 总数 2132, 期望频数为 (1199.25,399.75,399.75,133.25). 只有总频数约束, 所以 df=3.

Python 算得 X2=966.60996, 右尾 p≈3.15×10−209, 几乎为 0, 强烈拒绝独立分配.

紫花与长花粉、红花与圆花粉一起出现的次数远超独立模型, 表明两基因很可能在同一染色体上相距较近, 存在 **genetic linkage 遗传连锁**, 因而倾向于一起遗传.

独立模型预期亲本组合与重组组合按 9:3:3:1 出现. 实际两类亲本组合 1528 和 381 明显偏多, 两类重组组合 106 和 117 明显偏少, 卡方统计量因此极大.

统计检验拒绝的是独立分配比例, 连锁是对这一现象的生物学解释. 它不是只凭某一个表型人数多就下结论, 而是比较四类计数的整体比例.

卡方齐性与独立性检验
Chi-square Tests for Homogeneity and Independence

4.6 卡方齐性检验
4.6 Chi-square test for homogeneity

Pages 14–15

This is a test to see if several independent sets of random data are all drawn from the same distribution. (The meaning of homogeneity in this case is that all the distributions are the same.)

  • Use: Test whether m different independent sets of discrete data are drawn from the same distribution.
  • Outcomes: ω1​,ω2​,…,ωn​ are the possible outcomes. These are the same for each set of data.
  • Data: We assume m independent sets of data giving counts for each of the possible outcomes. That is, for data set i we have an observed count Oi,j​ for each possible outcome ωj​.
  • Assumptions: None
  • H0​: Each data set is drawn from the same distribution. (We don’t specify what this distribution is.)
  • HA​: The data sets are not all drawn from the same distribution.

齐性检验比较多个独立数据集的类别分布. H0​ 只说它们共享同一个分布, 不预先指定共同概率是多少, 所以要由合并数据估计.

Page 14
  • Test statistic: See the example below. There are mn cells containing counts for each outcome for each data set. Using the null distribution we can estimate expected counts for each of the data sets. The statistics X2 and G are computed exactly as above.
  • Degrees of freedom df: (m−1)(n−1). (See the example below.)
  • The null distribution χ2(df). The p-values are computed just as in the chi-square test for goodness of fit.
  • R code: The R function chisq.test can be used to do the computations for a chi-square test use X2. For G you either have to do it by hand or find a package that has a function. (It will probably be called likelihood.test or G.test.

**chi-square test for homogeneity 卡方齐性检验**比较多个独立样本的类别分布是否相同. 每个单元格的期望频数是「所在行总数 × 所在列总数 ÷ 总总数」. r 行 c 列时, df=(r−1)(c−1).

它与拟合优度检验的区别是: 这里共同的类别概率未知, 要由合并数据估计; 拟合优度检验中的概率通常由 H0​ 指定.

齐性与独立性检验共用列联表公式, 但问题语境不同. 齐性强调多个样本是否同分布, 独立性强调同一样本中的两个分类变量是否无关; 计算时都要保留边际总数.

三种治疗的治愈率
Chi-square test for homogeneity

Slides 7–9

Setting: We have several data sets (for example results of applying several different treatments; or polling data from several different states).

Homogeneity (the null hypothesis) means that the data sets are all drawn from the same distribution, e.g. that all the treatments are equally effective, or that Connecticut voters have the same political opinions as those in New York.

Example. Three treatments for a disease are compared in a clinical trial, yielding the following data:

Treatment 1Treatment 2Treatment 3
Cured503012
Not cured1008018

Use a chi-square test to compare the cure rates for the three treatments, i.e. to test if all three cure rates are the same.

表格按「治愈 / 未治愈」和三种治疗形成 2×3 列联表. 要检验的是三组治愈率是否相同, 而不是比较哪一组样本量更大.

Slides 7–8

Solution

H0​= all three treatments have the same cure rate.

HA​= the three treatments do not all have the same cure rate.

Expected counts

Under H0​ the MLE for the cure rate is (total cured)/(total treated) = 92/290 = 0.317.

Assuming H0​, the expected number cured for each treatment is estimated by the number_treated × 0.317.

This gives the following table of observed and expected counts (observed: on left, in black; expected: on right, in blue).

We include the marginal totals (in orange). These are all used to compute the expected counts.

Treatment 1Treatment 2Treatment 3Total
Cured50, 47.630, 34.912, 9.592
Not cured100, 102.480, 75.118, 20.5198
Total15011030290

在 H0​ 下, 三组共享治愈率 92/290. 每组期望治愈人数就是本组治疗人数乘这个共同率, 未治愈期望则由本组总数减去治愈期望.

边际总数既用于估计共同率, 也用于分配期望频数, 因此后面的自由度只剩 2.

期望公式来自「各组治愈率相同」: 每组治愈期望 = 本组人数 × 共同治愈率. 用合并数据估计共同率后, 各组观察与期望的差异才反映是否真的不同.

Slides 8–9

Likelihood ratio statistic: G=2∑i​Oi​ln(Oi​/Ei​)=2.12

Pearson’s chi-square statistic: X2=∑i​(Oi​−Ei​)2/Ei​=2.13

Degrees of freedom

Using the formula: Test for homogeneity df=(2−1)(3−1)=2.

By counting: The marginal totals are fixed because they are needed to compute the expected counts. So we can freely put values in 2 of the cells and then all the others are determined: degrees of freedom = 2.

Null distribution: ϕ(X2∣H0​)∼χ2(2) (Chi-square with 2 degrees of freedom.)

p-value: p=1−pchisq(2.12, 2)=0.346 (right-sided)

The data does not support rejecting H0​. We do not conclude that the treatments have differing efficacy.

共同治愈率的估计是 92/290. 由此得到各组期望治愈与未治愈人数, 再对所有 6 个单元格求和. Python 核对得 G=2.12357, X2=2.13425; 两者在 df=2 下的 p 值分别为 0.34584 和 0.343995.

数据不支持拒绝三种治愈率相同, 但也不是证明三者疗效完全一样. 样本信息不足时同样可能不显著.

自由度也可以直接数: 固定三组的样本量和总治愈、未治愈数后, 在 2×3 表中只需知道两个适当格子的值, 其他格子就能由边际总数推出. 因此 df=2.

两个统计量的 p 值都在 0.34 左右, 说明这种程度的组间差异在共同治愈率模型下并不罕见.

莎士比亚文本的词频
Example 12.

Pages 14–16

Someone claims to have found a long lost work by William Shakespeare. They ask you to test whether or not the play was actually written by Shakespeare.

You go to https://www.opensourceshakespeare.org and pick a random 12 pages from King Lear and count the use of common words. You do the same thing for the ‘long lost work’. You get the following table of counts.

Wordaanthisthat
King Lear150303090
Long lost work90201080

Using this data, set up and evaluate a significance test of the claim that the long lost book is by William Shakespeare. Use a significance level of 0.1.

本题先检验两份文本的四种词是否具有相同相对频率. 这个统计问题与「作品是否出自莎士比亚」相关, 但并不完全等同, 后文还需要代表性假设.

Page 15

Solution: The null hypothesis H0​: For the 4 words counted the long lost book has the same relative frequencies as the counts taken from King Lear.

The total word count of both books combined is 500, so the the maximum likelihood estimate of the relative frequencies assuming H0​ is simply the total count for each word divided by the total word count.

WordaanthisthatTotal count
King Lear150303090300
Long lost work90201080200
totals2405040170500
rel. frequencies under H0​240/50050/50040/500170/500500/500

Now the expected counts for each book under H0​ are the total count for that book times the relative frequencies in the above table. The following table gives the counts: (observed, expected) for each book.

WordaanthisthatTotals
King Lear(150, 144)(30, 30)(30, 24)(90, 102)(300, 300)
Long lost work(90, 96)(20, 20)(10, 16)(80, 68)(200, 200)
Totals(249, 240)(50, 50)(40, 40)(170, 170)(500, 500)

合并两份文本后, 每种词的共同相对频率由该词总数除以 500 估计. 再分别乘两文本的总词数 300 和 200, 得到各格期望频数.

例如《李尔王》中 a 的期望为 300×240/500=144, 与表中一致. 这个计算正是「行总数 × 列总数 ÷ 总总数」.

Page 15

The chi-square statistic is

X2=i∑​Ei​(Oi​−Ei​)2​=14462​+3002​+2462​+102122​+9662​+2002​+1662​+68122​≈7.9.

There are 8 cells and all the marginal counts are fixed because they were needed to determine the expected counts. To be consistent with these statistics we could freely set the values in 3 cells in the table, e.g. the 3 blue cells, then the rest of the cells are determined in order to make the marginal totals correct. Thus df=3. (Or we could recall that df=(m−1)(n−1)=(3)(1)=3, where m is the number of columns and n is the number of rows.)

Using R we find p=1−pchisq(7.9,3)=0.048. Since this is less than our significance level of 0.1 we reject the null hypothesis that the relative frequencies of the words are the same in both books.

If we make the further assumption that all of Shakespeare’s plays have similar word frequencies (which is something we could check) we conclude that the book is probably not by Shakespeare.

合并两份文本估计共同词频, 再按各文本的总词数分配期望频数. Python 核对 X2=7.9044118, df=(2−1)(4−1)=3, p=0.0480291, 所以在 0.1 水平拒绝相对词频相同.

拒绝的只是「这四种词的相对频率相同」. 要推进到作者身份, 还必须有额外假设: 《李尔王》的抽样能代表莎士比亚作品, 不同作品的词频足够稳定, 且抽页和计数方式恰当.

词频还会随作品主题、体裁、角色和写作时期变化. 即使两文本在这四个词上显著不同, 也只能说明它们不像来自同一个词频模型, 不能单独证明作者是谁.

因此最后结论应理解为在额外文学与抽样假设下的推断, 而不是卡方检验直接识别了作者.

原文笔误:期望频数表最后一行 a 列的观测总数写成 (249,240), 应为 (240,240), 因为 150+90=240. 后续计算用的是正确值.

幻灯片前后不一致:4.6 节先以 m 表示数据集数、n 表示结果类别数; Example 12 末尾却让 m 表示列数、n 表示行数. 两种写法在本例都给 df=3, 但统一按 r 行 c 列写成 df=(r−1)(c−1) 更清楚.

婚姻次数与教育水平
Board question: chi-square for independence

Slide 17

(From Rice, Mathematical Statistics and Data Analysis, 2nd ed. p.489)

Consider the following contingency table of counts

EducationMarried onceMarried multiple timesTotal
College55061611
No college681144825
Total12312051436

Use a chi-square test with significance level 0.01 to test the hypothesis that the number of marriages and education level are independent.

H0​ 为教育水平与婚姻次数类别独立. 按「行总数 × 列总数 ÷ 1436」计算, 四个期望频数依次为

EducationMarried onceMarried multiple times
College523.775187.2249
No college707.2249117.7751

Python 算得 X2=16.009764, df=(2−1)(2−1)=1, p=0.00006302. 因 p<0.01, 拒绝独立性假设. 数据表明两个变量在该样本中有关联, 但关联本身不证明教育导致婚姻次数变化.

独立性检验与齐性检验使用同一个期望公式, 差别在研究问题的表述: 这里问两个分类变量是否独立, 而不是几组独立样本是否来自同一总体.

其他检验
Other Tests

Page 16

There are far too many other tests to even make a dent. We will see some of them in class and on psets. Again, we urge you to master the paradigm of NHST and recognize the importance of choosing a test statistic with a known null distribution.

本讲列出的是常见入口, 不是完整菜单. 面对新检验仍按同一流程: 明确假设与数据结构, 检查适用条件, 找到统计量的零分布, 预先确定尾侧和显著性水平, 再计算并解释结果.

选择时可按顺序自问: 数据是连续测量还是类别计数? 比较一个总体、两个总体还是多个总体? 两组独立还是配对? 方差已知、相等还是不等? 回答后再查相应统计量和零分布, 比按名称死记更可靠.

得出显著或不显著后, 还要回到研究问题: 效应有多大, 模型是否合理, 是否有多重比较, 结果是否支持因果解释. 检验只完成其中一步, 不代替整段科学论证.

统计显著也不等于实际意义重大, 不显著也不等于效应不存在. 报告时应同时保留数据结构、检验方法、自由度、p 值和必要的模型限制, 让读者能够复核.
